question_text: A 57-year-old man comes to the physician because of a 2-year history of fatigue, worsening shortness of breath, and a productive cough for 2 years. He has smoked 1 pack of cigarettes daily for the past 40 years. Examination shows pursed-lip breathing and an increased anteroposterior chest diameter. opd. Thickness of small airways
ope. Pulmonary vascular pressure
